content.text:
**Use ChatGPT mobile’s Remote tab to continue yyot on this Mac.** That keeps your current files, tools, and chat context available through Codex. [OpenAI’s guide](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001275-chatgpt-work-and-codex)

1. **Update both apps:** ChatGPT on your phone and Codex on your Mac.
2. **Use the same ChatGPT account** on both devices.
3. **Enable remote access** in Codex’s settings, if prompted.
4. **Keep your Mac awake, online, and Codex running.** yyot’s work will execute here.
5. **Open Remote on your phone**, select this Mac, then open yyot and this chat. Send: “Check the yyot working directory and report the current state without changing anything.”

**yyot is already registered as a local project.** You don’t need to upload the repository for this route.

If you want work to continue **while the Mac is asleep**, we’d prepare a Codex Cloud environment separately. This checkout currently has no Git remote and substantial uncommitted work, so it needs a reviewed source snapshot first. [Cloud setup](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001545-using-codex-cloud)

**Open ChatGPT on your phone and check for the Remote tab.**
